svg.title: index writes a deterministic manifest
svg.desc: index reports seven documents, seven pages all parsed, 21 chunks and zero unparsed files for fixtures/seed_archive, with manifest_sha256 b59e497de998c0501208749c2e812712b86d59c8bf0ac4d5a4d972608fcff09e. Parse boundaries are fixed per file type and every failure enters the excluded ledger with a reason.
